agent_summary: Customer reports account blocked without notice and requests reason + unblock. Human-only ticket type per policy. No transactions, refunds, or other IDs provided. Route to risk team for manual review.
customer_reply_draft: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. A specialist is currently reviewing your account block to determine the reason and next steps. You will hear back from us shortly with an update.
next_action_for_human: Risk team to review account block reason and initiate unblock if approved; customer to be notified of outcome.

proposed_actions.name: send_reply
proposed_actions.rationale: Customer needs an immediate acknowledgment and explanation while a human reviews the block.

reasoning: Facts: Customer says account blocked without notice and wants reason/unblock. Rule: account_blocked is a human-only ticket type per policy_summary. Action: ROUTE to risk team with send_reply to acknowledge and set expectation.
